limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the steady-state waveform periods but changes behavior the reference preserves: square mode now forces zero on entry instead of holding the previous output, and triangle mode starts by incrementing from reset instead of decrementing.
The testbench explicitly expects the rewritten triangle to produce 1 on the first clock after reset, so it passes rather than exposing the reference mismatch, which produces 31 on that clock.
